name: EVENTS_PIPE
definition:
COPY INTO EVSNOW_ELASTIC_261005_1931.PUBLIC.EVENTS (EVENT_BODY,EVENTHUB_NAMESPACE,EVENTHUB_NAME,PARTITION_ID,SEQUENCE_NUMBER,OFFSET,ENQUEUED_TIME,INGESTION_TIMESTAMP)
FROM (SELECT $1:event_body::VARCHAR,$1:eventhub_namespace::VARCHAR,$1:eventhub_name::VARCHAR,$1:partition_id::VARCHAR,$1:sequence_number::NUMBER(38,0),$1:offset::VARCHAR,$1:enqueued_time::TIMESTAMP_LTZ,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() FROM TABLE(DATA_SOURCE(TYPE=>'STREAMING')))
